The front bumper geometry appears slightly warped and lacks sharp definition. The headlight assembly merges indistinctly into the fender, lacking clear mechanical separation lines typical of real cars.
The slots in the rally-style wheel show slight inconsistency in perspective depth; some slots appear to flatten out unnaturally towards the bottom of the wheel.
